description: This file defines the AppStateObserverService class, which manages app state change events within a React Native environment. It listens to app state transitions such as backgrounding, resuming, and losing focus, and emits corresponding custom events.

classes.name: AppStateObserverService
classes.description: A service class that observes and handles app state changes, emitting custom events based on app lifecycle transitions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up event listeners for app state changes, and manages the internal event bus.

methods.name: beginIgnoringStateChanges
methods.description: Sets a flag to ignore subsequent state change events.

methods.name: stopIgnoringStateChanges
methods.description: Clears the ignore flag, allowing state change events to be processed.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes the app state change event listener.

methods.name: notifyStateChange
methods.description: Updates the recent state and emits a custom event for the state change.
